prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent 4x4 cutout-animation parts atlas for the exact rear-view man in reference 1. Reference 1 determines identity, original BACK view with head slightly turned right, light blue pajama cloth/white piping, body proportions and painterly faceted brushwork. Reference 2 is only the required parts-chart layout, never a front-view replacement. Do not redesign the face, hair, clothing, slipper or camera. This is for a fixed oblique overhead 2D game, with top of hair and shoulders visible, borrowing restrained painterly surfaces of Disco Elysium and readable shapes of Death's Door, while keeping this project's existing character painting. Separate intact parts; do not make walking frames. Genuine transparent background; no ground/shadow/checkerboard/text/labels/grid. Square image, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, each equal cell, large clear margins so parts never overlap cells. Keep all parts complete, joints with painted overlap extensions. No detached collar fragments. Ends must have usable solid painted overlap, not deep dark holes. Hands and feet retain the source rear perspective. Maintain uniform physical scale as much as possible; do not enlarge the small hands to fill cells.
Cell order reading left-to-right: row1: head/hair/neck rear view, whole BACK torso/shirt NO arms and no front buttons or chest pocket, trouser hip/pelvis band, screen-left upper arm shoulder-to-elbow. Row2: screen-left forearm sleeve elbow-to-cuff WITHOUT hand, screen-left hand/wrist rear view, screen-right upper arm, screen-right forearm WITHOUT hand. Row3: screen-right hand/wrist, screen-left thigh, screen-left shin/ankle cuff, screen-left slipper/foot including short ankle. Row4: screen-right thigh, screen-right shin, screen-right slipper/foot/short ankle, EMPTY transparent. Exactly15 parts, no assembled figure, no extra versions. Preserve actual rear pajama seams, fabric color, hair silhouette and delicate existing brush texture from reference1.
